record.question: Choose the incorrect statement from the followings in relation to the law of contracts:
options: It does not lay down so many precise rights and duties which the law will protect and enforce
It contains a number of limiting principles, subject to which the parties may creat rights and duties for themselves
The parties to a contract in a sense make the law for themselves
All the above statements are correct
record.explanation: The printed question (Civil Engineering Paper-II, Nov 2018, Q60, PDF page 6) asks for the incorrect statement. Statements (a), (b) and (c) are each a correct description of the general law of contracts (it lays down few precise rights, it has limiting principles, and parties effectively make their own law), so none is incorrect and the option stating all are correct is chosen.
